senses.gloss: m. (a contract. of זערזער; cmp. זוּטָא) small, young, junior.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 119:141">Targ. Ps. CXIX, 141</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Ketubot 66b:6">Keth. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>עסקא זוטא דזוטר רווחא</he> a small investment which brings a small profit, v. <cite ref="G00314"><he>זִיּוּנָא</he> III</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זוּטְרֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:17">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00131"><he>גַּבְרָא</he></cite>; a. e.—Fem. <cite ref="G00164"><he>זוּטַרְתָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="G00164"><he>זוּטַרְתִּי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 29a:6">Ab. Zar. 29ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01492"><he>מְלוֹא</he></cite> ch.—Pl. <cite ref="G00164"><he>זוֹטְרָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 104:25">Targ. Ps. CIV, 25</cite> Ms. (ed. <he>זעיר׳</he>).—
Zeb. 63ᵃ בז׳ Ar. (v. marginal note, ed. בזכרותא) counting the little fingers (of which six go on a Tefaḥ).
